clean_sources.use: Primitive null, boolean, integer, ordered-array, object-order, UTF-8, newline, NFC, and SHA-256 behavior was used only to select a minimal compatibility subset.
The clean committed integer-only canonicalization implementation was inspected only to identify shared primitive cases; no current working-tree bytes were read into a vector.

independent_edge_vector_policy: Every vector labelled INDEPENDENT_PROFILE_EDGE was authored for the new candidate profile and is not attributed to a prototype fixture or validator.
non_adoption: No modified, untracked, or otherwise dirty V2 working-tree file is a source for these vectors.
No prototype record, schema meaning, scientific status, release status, or admission status is adopted.
The clean-source bindings establish provenance for a deliberately minimal primitive compatibility subset only.
